name: Miami Beach (United States)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and green, charged at the centre with the city seal in white and green reading MIAMI BEACH INCORPORATED MARCH 26TH 1915.
history: Miami Beach is a coastal resort city in Miami-Dade County, Florida. Flags of the World records that the original flag was designed by Rose Weiss, "the mother of Miami Beach", and presented to Mayor J. N. Lummus on 26 March 1915 at incorporation; the present yellow-over-green colouring is believed to be the winner of a 2003 contest.
